title: Experience Center Analytics: the dashboard and report families and which subject owns each

prose.label: Health360.
prose.text: Deployment health scores and Best Practices are in [[unified.analytics.health360]]; license adoption and the executive views are in [[unified.analytics.health360.adoption]].

prose.label: Risk360 and Business Insights.
prose.text: {{risk360-views}} The Risk360 product is in [[risk360.overview]]. {{business-insights-views}} The Business Insights product is in [[business-insights.overview]].

prose.label: Cybersecurity and Data Security.
prose.text: The Cybersecurity dashboards are in [[unified.analytics.cybersecurity]], and the Data Security dashboards in [[unified.analytics.data-security]]. The Data Security Incidents view is described in [[zwa.incident-analytics]].

prose.label: Digital Experience.
prose.text: {{digital-experience-views}} The ZDX pages behind them are in [[zdx.dashboards]].

prose.label: Infrastructure.
prose.text: {{infrastructure-views}} The Client Connector dashboard is described in [[zcc.devices.dashboard]]; how its pages relate to the four Client Connector entries here is open {{gap:zcc-dashboard-count}}. The Connector Activity dashboard is in [[unified.analytics.networking]], and Zero Trust Branch in [[zero-trust-branch.overview]].

prose.label: Reports.
prose.text: {{reports-views}} {{system-audit-report}} {{interactive-500}} The ZIA reports are in [[zia.reports]] and [[zia.reports.interactive]].

prose.label: Custom dashboards.
prose.text: Dashboards that an admin builds are in [[unified.analytics.custom-dashboards]].

checks.do: Which Analytics family a dashboard belongs to, and whether the tenant's subscriptions give the admin access to it, before treating a missing dashboard as a fault.

purpose.statement: Analytics in the Zscaler Admin Console is a set of dashboards and reports for monitoring end-user digital experience, cyber risk and deployment health, among others. Which dashboards and reports an admin has access to depends on the organization's Zscaler subscriptions.

quotes: Analytics within the Zscaler Admin Console provides a comprehensive set of dashboards and reports that allow you to monitor end-user digital experience, cyber risk, deployment health, etc.
The dashboards and reports you have access to are dependent upon the Zscaler subscriptions that apply for your organization.

families.statement: The Analytics section's families are Health360, Risk360, Business Insights, Cybersecurity, Data Security, Digital Experience, Infrastructure, Custom Dashboards and Reports.

quotes: | Health360 | Delivers centralized visibility into the deployment, health, and performance of your Zscaler environment.
| Risk360 | Analyzes your organization's security data
| Business Insights | Provides 360-degree visibility into your organization's SaaS application usage and spending insights
| Cybersecurity | Provides information about malicious activity that affects your organization.
| Data Security | Provides information about incidents, users, channels, and data at rest in your organization
| Digital Experience | Provides a multi-tenant, cloud-based monitoring platform
| Infrastructure | Provides a series of dashboards and reports for Zscaler Client Connector, Cloud & Branch Connector, and Zero Trust Branch.
| Custom Dashboards | In addition to a robust set of preconfigured dashboards
| Reports | Provides a series of dashboards and reports that highlight security data for key entities across your organization.

risk360-views.statement: Under Risk360, Analytics lists Factors, Assets, Insights, Financial Risk, Alerts and MITRE ATT&CK, and compliance views for PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, NIS2, ISO 27001, HITRUST, HIPAA, DORA, CIS, CAF, SOC 2 and GDPR.

quotes: Factors: Shows the list of contributing factors that are affecting your organization's risk score.
Assets: Aggregates and visualizes the total number of assets in your organization
Insights: Gives visibility into your organization's current risks and vulnerabilities.
Financial Risk: Gives visibility into your organization's potential financial loss exposure for your current risk score.
Alerts: Helps you meet your security compliance requirements
MITRE ATT&CK: Highlights each attacker's journey
PCI DSS: Provides data related to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)
NIST CSF: Provides data related to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) cybersecurity framework (CSF)
NIST SP 800-53: Provides data related to
NIS2: Provides data related to the Network and Information Security Directive 2 (NIS2)
ISO 27001: Provides data related to the ISO 27001
HITRUST: Provides data related to the HITRUST compliance
HIPAA: Provides data related to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
DORA: Provides data related to the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA)
CIS: Provides data related to the Center for Internet Security (CIS) Critical Security Controls
CAF: Provides data related to the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF)
SOC 2: Provides data related to the System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2) standard
GDPR: Provides data related to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

business-insights-views.statement: Under Business Insights, Analytics lists Application Insights, All Applications, Application Settings (for configuring an application connector or customer application signature), Workplace Insights, Offices and Locations (data for Internet & SaaS locations and inferred IP addresses), Workplace Settings and Data Explorer (attendance and operations metrics for configured offices).

quotes: Application Insights: Provides a holistic overview of the applications that are currently being used across your organization.
All Applications: Shows the list of apps whose usage is discovered within your organization.
Application Settings: Lets you configure an application connector or customer application signature for which you want to view insights.
Workplace Insights: Provides metrics related to workplaces and their workforces across the globe for an organization.
Offices and Locations: Provides data for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) locations and inferred IP addresses.
Workplace Settings: Provides information about the offices that you configured for your organization.
Data Explorer: Provides attendance and operations metrics about the offices that you configured for your organization.

digital-experience-views.statement: Under Digital Experience, Analytics lists Incidents, Network Intelligence, Applications Overview and Devices Overview.

quotes: Incidents: Provides an overview of incidents affecting your organization.
Network Intelligence: Provides end-to-end multi-path network visibility from Last Mile Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) to applications.
Applications Overview: Provides an overview of application performance in your organization.
Devices Overview: Provides a comprehensive device health scoreboard that monitors the performance of devices.

infrastructure-views.statement: Under Infrastructure, Analytics lists the Client Connector entries Platform Details, Device Overview, Device Posture (criteria evaluated on devices) and Device Events (Private Access and Internet & SaaS service status), plus Connector Activity (Cloud Connector and Branch Connector activity) and Zero Trust Branch (widgets on assets, VLANs, gateways and devices).

quotes: Platform Details: Provides OS platform details such as device model and device state.
Device Overview: Provides an overview of the devices in use in your organization.
Device Posture: Provides an overview of criteria evaluated on devices in your organization.
Device Events: Provides an overview of Private Access (ZPA) and Internet & SaaS (ZIA) service status for your organization.
Connector Activity: Provides an overview of Cloud Connector and Branch Connector activity in your organization.
Zero Trust Branch: Provides customizable widgets that display important information about the assets, VLANs, gateways, and devices in your organization

reports-views.statement: Under Reports, Analytics lists Industry Peer Comparison, System Audit Report, Security Policy Audit Report, Sandbox Activity Report, SaaS Security Report, Configuration Risk Report, IOT Discovery Report, Risk360 Reports, ZPA QBR Reports, ZDX QBR Reports and Interactive Reports.

quotes: System Audit Report: Highlights the status of GRE tunnels
Interactive Reports: Provides a wide range of standard reports
Industry Peer Comparison: Compares your organization's performance and effectiveness for the preceding month
Security Policy Audit Report: Allows you to view your Security Policy settings
Sandbox Activity Report: Highlights the Sandbox policy action taken for known and unknown files in your organization.
SaaS Security Report: Provides a breakdown of applications by their status
Configuration Risk Report: Provides an evaluation of your organization's policy configuration, traffic patterns, and feature capabilities against Zscaler's best practices.
IOT Discovery Report: Provides a device inventory and insights discovered from unauthenticated web traffic in your organization.
Risk360 Reports: Provides links to download various risk-related reports from the Reports page.
ZPA QBR Reports: Provide extensive insight into emerging traffic trends based on private application usage
ZDX QBR Reports: Provides extensive insight into how Zscaler is helping protect your network, quarter to quarter.

system-audit-report.statement: The System Audit Report highlights the status of GRE tunnels, PAC files, authentication frequency, PAC file sizes, Microsoft 365 One Click and IP visibility.

quotes: System Audit Report: Highlights the status of GRE tunnels, PAC files, authentication frequency, PAC file sizes, Microsoft 365 One Click, and IP visibility.

interactive-500.statement: Interactive Reports provides standard reports based on the organization's subscriptions and the ability to create up to 500 custom reports.

quotes: Interactive Reports: Provides a wide range of standard reports, based on your organization's subscriptions, and provides the ability to create up to 500 custom reports, as well.

zcc-dashboard-count.title: How the Client Connector dashboard's pages relate to the four Client Connector entries under Infrastructure
zcc-dashboard-count.detail: The Analytics overview lists four Client Connector entries (Platform Details, Device Overview, Device Posture, Device Events). The Client Connector dashboard subject describes three pages (Platform Details, Device Posture, Device Events). The sources do not say whether both count the same dashboard, so no divergence is recorded: Device Overview is not described on the Client Connector page.
